subject: Marketplace renewal - multi-tranche commit & invoicing segmentation
messages:
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@medicohealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@medicohealth.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Medico renewal - request to accept quarterly-tranche private offer

Hi Kimberly,

We're ready to move forward with the private offer you shared for the coming 12 months, but procurement has one ask: can Redwood accept the commitment as three quarterly tranches tied to regional activation windows?

Summary of what we need:
- Total committed spend: $1.8M/year, split into 3 tranches ($600k per tranche) billed at the start of each quarter.
- We need separate invoice lines per tranche (so our accounting can map to different internal cost centers).
- DocuSign acceptance and a single signed PO referencing the Azure private offer are acceptable; we just need the invoice segmentation and a PO number on the invoices.

For context, procurement attached a draft PO for your review.
(attachment: Medico_PO_draft.pdf, 85KB, PDF)

Can you confirm technical acceptance on your side and whether any marketplace constraints (Azure private offer) would prevent this staged invoicing?

Thanks,
Sofia Ramos
Head of Procurement, Medico Health
sofia.ramos@medicohealth.com

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@medicohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Medico renewal - request to accept quarterly-tranche private offer

Hi Sofia — thanks for the clear note and the PO draft. Looping in Marissa (marketplace lead) and Priyom (deal ops) to confirm feasibility and recommended acceptance path.

Quick answers up front:
- We can accept a single signed private-offer PO and implement invoicing segmentation, but we need to coordinate how Azure Marketplace records acceptance vs how our billing team issues segmented invoices.
- We should confirm the exact PO fields required on each invoice (PO number, billing contact, remit-to).

Marissa/Priyom — can you review the attached PO and propose a minimal contract amendment language and acceptance playbook?

Kimberly Park
Head of Cloud Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:20:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Medico renewal - staging acceptance + Azure constraints

Thanks Kim — reviewed the PO. I recommend: 

1) Staggered acceptance via single DocuSign envelope that includes a short amendment: "Redwood agrees to accept the commitment as three tranche activations; invoicing will be issued per tranche as specified in the invoice schedule." This keeps marketplace acceptance as one action while allowing us to issue segmented invoices.

2) Operational plan: 
- Tranche 1: Activate US region immediately on signature (invoice issued at signing).
- Tranche 2: Activate EU region 90 days later (invoice issued at start of Q2).
- Tranche 3: Activate APAC 180 days later (invoice issued at start of Q3).

3) Azure marketplace note: Azure Private Offer contracts need a single acceptance flow; they do not natively support multiple marketplace acceptances for a single private offer. The DocuSign amendment approach above is the least risky.

Attachments I prep'd for ops: Azure_PO_Template.docx (amendment language), staggered-invoice-example.xlsx (billing lines template), onboarding-playbook.pdf (activation checklist).
(attachment: Azure_PO_Template.docx)
(attachment: staggered-invoice-example.xlsx)

I also recommend adding a 30-day usage true-up at each tranche boundary so Medico's teams are not charged for capacity they didn't use. We can bake that into the amendment.

Marissa Cole
Marketplace Programs
Redwood Inference

---

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Medico renewal - staging acceptance + Azure constraints

Agree with Marissa's approach. A few operational clarifications from deal ops / billing:

- We will need the PO number present on each invoice and a single signed amendment that references the PO number and the tranche schedule.
- Finance can support issuing three invoices per the tranche schedule provided we have a billing contact and remit-to address per tranche.
- Please confirm whether Medico wants invoices net-30 from invoice date or vendor-specific terms (we'll mirror the PO).

Suggested contract clause (short form) for the amendment: 
"The Parties agree that the Total Commitment will be allocated into three (3) Tranche Commitments as set forth in Exhibit A. Redwood will issue invoices tied to each Tranche in accordance with the invoice schedule. Acceptance of this Amendment via DocuSign constitutes acceptance of the underlying Azure Private Offer for purposes of marketplace enrollment."

I can push the amendment into DocuSign once Kimberly confirms language and Ben confirms invoicing mechanics.

Priyom Das
Deal Operations
Redwood Inference
